summary: Iteration 137: Tested P2 Smart-routed SPREAD orders, P1 Tier 3 paper-days progress endpoint, and regression tests. All 14 backend tests passed. Smart-routed spreads working correctly with routing.mode=smart, estimated_spread, spread_per_leg array. Direct-route mode also working with routing.mode=direct. Tier3-progress endpoint returns all expected fields (days, target_days, remaining_days, progress_pct, unlocked, first_trade_at, last_trade_at, total_trades). Frontend UI testing had difficulty navigating to Admin Panel modal due to complex UI interactions.

integration_issues.issue: Difficulty navigating to Admin Panel modal via Playwright - avatar dropdown not opening consistently. Manual testing recommended for Conviction tab UI verification.

issues: React key warnings in console: 'Encountered two children with the same key' for bid/ask values - minor but should be fixed

action_items: Manually verify Admin Panel → Conviction tab → Paper Days card renders correctly with 4-column grid
Fix React key warnings for bid/ask values in dashboard components
critical_code_review_comments: MLHealthStrip.jsx correctly implements 4-card grid with lg:grid-cols-4
Smart router spread functionality correctly implemented with pick_for_spread and route_spread methods

success_rate.frontend: Unable to fully verify Admin Panel UI due to navigation issues

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend APIs for smart-routed spreads and tier3-progress are fully functional. Frontend Admin Panel access requires clicking user avatar dropdown then 'Admin Panel' menu item. The Conviction tab contains MLHealthStrip with 4 cards including the new Paper Days card. estimated_spread=1e9 is expected sentinel value when TRADIER_API_TOKEN is not set.
